fact: Merankabandi II coordinator Michel Nyabenda said registration into the Registre social unique continues, with 249,671 households already enrolled against a final target of 290,000.
President Ndayishimiye highlighted progress made in setting up the registre social unique at the opening of the ninth CNPS general assembly.

The World Bank says investments in a Unified Social Registry and CORE-MIS enable transparent targeting and have established the foundations of Burundi's national social protection system, used to identify over 100,000 flood- and food-crisis-affected households.

The World Bank says Merankabandi's Social Registry is also used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar energy project to reach vulnerable households, and that the systems are increasingly used across sectors and by other programmes.
